semantics.authority: Native owns stdin/stdout directly. Enable only the exact local profile with verified sidecar instance nonce and PPID, first hello binds current Native process epoch/owner/tenant. Market mode logs only safe diagnostics to stderr. HTTP bearer is machine access, Trace is correlation only. Neither can register grants or decisions.
semantics.registration: Native validates current lease and normal chat/connector permissions under its authorization lock, freezes original SQL31 intent, resolves existing attachment inputs and compares current service installation revisions/generations before grant_register. Full immutable body travels only through this owned pipe; grants carry no platform secret and no free URL/env/command.
semantics.idempotency: Mutation operation IDs compare full typed intent, not only selection digest. Host durable full-intent HMAC excludes transport requestId/grantRef and renewed authority expiry/revision. Original accepted operation is returned before prepare/config/Runtime work. Pending/uncertain require original fact recovery, never a replacement operation or automatic repeated external call.
semantics.lifetime: Grant deadlines are min(trusted Native expiry remaining,300000ms), converted once to monotonic time. Repeat registration never renews a grant. Expired/revoked grant cannot execute; reauthorization requires a new grant referring to the same frozen intent and never revives a used lease. Bounded ephemeral full payloads are released after consume/expiry/revoke; retain only bounded safe receipt/identity as needed for replay.
semantics.submit: Only the trusted grant payload is executed. For new sessions use task mapping owned by this family and reject legacy collisions; initial expectedModelRevision0 precedes initial Host revision1. Under one existing model-operation lock: accepted receipt comparison first, prepare immutable selection, combine model/selection into one thread/start or idle/cold-resume, start actual turn, bind actual thread+turn. Empty selection removes every market tool and cannot inherit previous/global MCP.
semantics.revocation: Native permission or installation changes invalidate matching grants and capabilities through revoke_authority; reducing-authority actions must still work after expiry. EOF retires all grants and market capabilities before normal Host/Runtime cleanup. Preserve STOP_PENDING ownership; never force-kill, respawn or claim external rollback.
semantics.approvals: Legacy nonempty selection uses ask/on-request. A negotiated nativeApprovalVersion binds the frozen mode and registered call to Codex manual, Guardian, full or native memory decisions. Native default_tools_approval_mode=approve suppresses the duplicate pre-call prompt on the owned proxy only. The owner rechecks the actual turn, service, installation, arguments, risk and deadline before one call may be consumed. Writes without a qualified policy require explicit single-use review.
semantics.observations: Read routes never grant execution. Scope follows the pipe-bound local identity and stored market task/session ownership, not caller trace. Tool facts come from native items, approvals from actual pending calls. Optional linkage requires explicit trustworthy evidence; no matching by latest item/tool/arguments. Every GET requires canonical non-nil X-Yijie-Market-Request-Id and echoes it; correlation only, never grant authority. When no current Host exists Native returns scoped durable managed/selectionDisplay and omits unqueried remote facts without starting/probing a Host. With a current owned Host, known historical tool items may be read after matching owner/tenant, agent session, native thread and native turn even if the stored turn belongs to an older Host generation. Such reads never restore grants, capabilities or approval callbacks. Approval validation and decisions still require the current Host generation and exact current call. Current Host read failures remain typed errors. Recheck local view and task.read after asynchronous reads. Historical observations do not block a new explicitly authorized turn using fresh enabled refs and admission. ToolSnapshot.truncated indicates omitted result information, not merely an additional structuredContent copy. A complete text block that contains the identical JSON value ignoring object member order and JSON whitespace, while preserving numeric literals and array order already represents that structured copy; differing structured content is retained separately; actually omitted content is marked truncated. Native optional availableTurns/turnsTruncated exposes at most 128 original bound turns in reverse submission order without a new database or Runtime history reconstruction. Explicit historical reads use that turn's submitted display, preserve current approval authority separately, and never auto-select/replay tools. Unmanaged local sessions return without accessing Host. Gateway result _meta[yijie.market.call] may provide versioned read-only correlation; Host validates original operation/digest and Native validates original turn selection. Legacy or unrecognized metadata remains unlinked. No new approval database or execution state is created. P2: one bounded result projection is shared by native event/history/market views. Preserve structured-only JSON and separate differing content/structured JSON. The tools HTTP read accepts source=events for a disposable bounded native-notification projection; missing source or source=history retains actual thread/read. Event snapshots are not execution state, and cannot create or replay calls. Native toolsRead=none skips tool reads, events selects that snapshot, history forces refresh. Current UI invalidates from its existing native subscription; only lightweight approval polling remains. Original selected-turn decisionFacts are Native append-only intent/acknowledgement/unconfirmed evidence; missing acknowledgements never assert rejection, success or non-execution. Explicit toolsRead opts into local fact availability during remote failures: set remoteIssue and omit unusable remote facts; without that option preserve legacy typed failures. Keep live approval actions disabled when remoteIssue is present. Legacy tools HTTP reads with omitted source retain truncated=true when a separate structuredResultText would be invisible to an old reader. Explicit source=history/events opts into the separate-field projection. Only the owned yijie_market generic public identifier m_ followed by 60 lowercase hexadecimal digits is exempt from the command opaque-token display heuristic; it is generated by the worker from service/tool identity. Other namespaces and result contents keep normal redaction. The existing closed native v6 MCP display keeps original content indexes and its whole-line confidentiality projection. Structured-only or additional JSON is explicitly partial there and is fully exposed through the market observation fields; never fabricate native content blocks or indexes for structuredContent. Reaudit: a notification snapshot must cover the actual Items already obtained by a concurrent history read and must not replace their terminal observations with started/empty facts. Otherwise retain the history response and invalidate the incomplete snapshot. Active Native reads prioritize stored evidence for their exact currently pending approval/call identities before filling the bounded decision history; explicit historical reads retain their own turn scope. Decision history is ordered by append position, not wall-clock timestamps; acknowledgements retain their stronger evidence meaning. Finishing a read must drain an invalidation queued during finalization. Only the tools GET allows one optional source query parameter with value events or history; validate it before the ordinary no-body/canonical-ID check. Other GET routes retain their no-query contract.
semantics.rollback: New family outboxes and Host task mappings stay isolated from legacy paths. Feature-off readers preserve records but never downgrade/dispatch them as legacy. Legacy Sorftime execution is retired by Owner decision; its history and approval shapes remain readable, but cannot execute or authorize market calls. The legacy permission-scope route returns inactive without restarting Runtime. Rollback must not restore the retired writer or infer grants from history. Decision facts use forward migration 47 in the existing Native database; deploy the compatible reader first, preserve old data and receipts, retain that reader when disabling the writer, never downgrade or replay facts.
semantics.suspend: Explicit ordinary disable uses provider_suspend. Revoke execution admission, fence old operations and normally await owned client/callback cleanup, retaining credential generation/reference and Keyring configuration/OAuth tokens. No credential read, refresh or deletion is required to suspend. Return disconnected, not-qualified, executionAvailable=false; authorizationStatus=unknown does not erase persisted authorization metadata. Poll the same operation; cancellation cannot undo a reducing action. Cleanup pending is reported honestly. provider_forget remains explicit credential removal/uninstall only; never fall back to forget if suspend is unsupported. Normal EOF retains credentials. Deploy Worker, then Host, then Native before new requests; legacy request/response shapes and forget semantics are unchanged.
